title: Composition comparison factorization by right-derived units
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $U\subseteq Y$ an arbitrary open, $V=h^{-1}U$, and suppose the derived module categories of X, Y and all their opens exist in one morphism universe [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Let $\beta:Rj_{X*}Rh_*\cong Rg_*Rj_{Y*}$ be fixed to the canonical composite of the normalized composition comparisons. Write $\beta_0$ for the homotopy open-composition model [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model], $Q$ for homotopy localization and $\eta_T:QT\to RTQ$ for the right-derived unit. For every homotopy object K on V, the pasted units satisfy $\eta_h(j_{X*}K);Rh_*(\eta_{j_X}(K));\beta_{QK}=Q(\beta_{0,K});\eta_{j_Y}(g_*K);Rj_{Y*}(\eta_g(K))$. This contains no restriction functor or counit and has no K-injectivity hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 08FE, 0D5T and 08BV; official pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08FE, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0D5T and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08BV, read 2026-10-14

proof.text:
apply the determining unit equation of each chosen composition comparison.
Transport the middle unit along the equality jX followed by h = g followed by jY.
Naturality of the right-derived unit identifies this transport with the image of
the underived open-composition identification. Cancel the comparison for g followed
by jY and reassociate. The result is the equality of the two pasted units displayed
below. No restriction functor or adjunction counit enters this computation.
